Thus each complex is the direct sum of homology representatives with contractible two-term complexes. If $h$ contracts one such summand $A$, then $h\otimes 1$ contracts $A\otimes E$: the two cross terms cancel by the graded tensor signs, while $(\partial h+h\partial)\otimes1=1$. Hence $H(C\otimes D)\cong H(C)\otimes H(D)\cong\mathbb F_2$. By [F1], choose cycles $x\in F_tC$ and $y\in F_uD$ representing the nonzero homology classes.
